subtitle: Tennis, Teams & Coaching
promotionalText: Bring your tennis together: private team chats, practice sign-ups, Starter TiQ, courts and match plans. Pro adds Captain and Coach tools.
description:
More Tennis. One App.

Bring your game, your team and your next time on court together with TenAceIQ. Find places to play, organize practice and build your game with tools made for tennis.

BUILD YOUR GAME
Start in My Lab with Starter TiQ: a private, self-assessed 1–10 estimate across serve, return, rally, movement, net play and point decisions. Add singles or doubles answers for that format, choose a drill for your next practice, and track your self-recorded match results. Retake the assessment as your game changes.

KEEP YOUR TEAM TOGETHER
Create a private team and invite teammates with a link. Keep conversations organized, pin the chats you use most, collect practice sign-ups and keep match details close to the conversation.

PLAN AND COACH WITH PRO
Captain tools bring match details, player availability and court assignments together so you can prepare your team. Coach tools help you plan lessons, explain patterns on the tactics court, assign practice, review player check-ins and record dated coach observations.

FIND YOUR NEXT TIME ON COURT
Explore nearby tennis courts and browse TenAceIQ leagues and tournaments. Find divisions, enter events and follow schedules and draws in Compete.

RUN A LEAGUE OR TOURNAMENT
Schedule league matches, review submitted scores and keep approved results connected to the standings. Use Tournament Desk to manage divisions, entries and draws. Save a draft for free, then publish when you are ready.

Player is free. TenAceIQ Pro is an optional monthly subscription for Captain and Coach tools. Publishing a tournament or league season is a separate one-time purchase, including for Pro members.
